name: Mali Thai Kata
shortDescription: Boutique project of four private pool villas between Karon and Kata, with two- and three-bedroom homes of 199-349 sqm.
description:
Listed on property portals as Mali Thai Pool Villas, a boutique project of four private pool villas in the Karon sub-district, close to Kata Beach (about 1.1 km by some listings, 1.3 km to Wat Kitti Sangkharam by the portal).
The homes advertised are one two-bedroom villa of about 199 sqm and three-bedroom villas of 225-349 sqm with four bathrooms, with prices from THB 19.9 million. Communal garden, parking and 24-hour security are provided, and pets are not allowed.
The portal records completion in January 2025 while some listings still show off-plan units and a May 2026 date, and the construction payment plan (2% deposit, then 28/15/15/15/15/10%) is still published. Treat status and availability as unconfirmed.

researchNotes: New project added 2026-11-22. "Mali Thai Kata" not found under that name; mapped to Mali Thai Pool Villas (Karon). Confirm with the client that this is the intended project. Units: 4 (most) vs 5 (Hipflat). Completion Jan 2025 (portal) vs May 2026 (listing). Ownership conflicting (freehold and leasehold mentioned); not published. 7% rental programme in listings not published. Separate project "Mali Pool Villa" exists in Karon. All figures are advertised/third-party and not confirmed by the developer unless noted. Images added 2026-11-22 from the developer website (https://malithaivilla.com/). Nearby places refreshed 2026-11-23: beaches, hospitals, big stores (Tesco Lotus, Big C, Makro), markets, schools and kindergartens added from OpenStreetMap as straight-line distances from the FazWaz project coordinates (not road distance). Where a category already had a distance from the developer or a portal, it was kept and not replaced.
